comments.text:
Just some advice for you Cory to help: 

Unlike in the last game, all your moves (apples) are needed for each mission. You’ll know you’re on the right track when all your apples are gone. But there are specifics moves you need to make in a specific order. If you mess up the order then you’ll have to restart. 

Also the true ending to the game (no spoilers) requires you to collect all the monstermon cards. There are a total of 50. In order to collect some of them you’ll  have to battle students in monstermon card battles. You’ll need to collect 10 cards to start, but once you collect more you’ll need to pick out a good set in order to battle other kids and win. When you beat a kid at a battle they give you a card to collect. 

Like this so Cory can see.
